offering_description.value: Operates bowling and entertainment centers offering bowling lanes, arcade games, food and beverage, and party packages to families, friends, groups and league bowlers. It earns revenue from per-game and lane-time fees, event packages, and on-site food and drink sales at its company-owned venues.

primary_products.value: food and beverage; arcade game play; bowling merchandise

primary_services.value: bowling lane rental; party and event hosting; league bowling programs; corporate event hosting

customer_segment.value: B2C: families, friends, birthday party groups and casual bowlers; B2B: corporate event planners and bowling league organizers

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-game and lane-time fees for bowling; product sales: food, beverages and merchandise sold on site; transaction or usage fees: arcade game play and card usage; project or contract: party and corporate event packages
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; transaction or usage fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs bowling centers with lanes, buildings and equipment, selling play time to consumers; service provider: provides hosted entertainment and event services to individuals, groups and businesses; retailer: sells food, drinks and merchandise directly to visitors at its venues

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: niche specialist: bowling-based entertainment centers, with arcade games and food as add-ons to bowling

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned bowling and entertainment centers; online: online booking for lanes, leagues and party packages

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules apply, such as local food, alcohol and venue safety licensing
